scope: deterministic ChatWorkspace navigation guard; no model, server or user assets

red.command: project pnpm --filter @learning/frontend exec vitest run tests/ChatWorkspace.test.tsx -t "初始草稿读取挂起|版本冲突的未就绪"
red.symptom: new pristine chat saveDraft rejected with 草稿版本未核对 while initial GET draft was held

change: after all screenshot/file guards, flush current draft only when ready or dirty; saveAllDrafts still protects other dirty drafts; no empty-version POST and no wait on pristine initial read

covers: held pristine initial read navigates immediately without POST
held cached-dirty read still rejects and preserves local input
version conflict still rejects without overwriting server
queued confirmed screenshot on unready pristine draft still blocks navigation

regression.command: project pnpm --filter @learning/frontend exec vitest run tests/ChatWorkspace.test.tsx tests/ChatCaptureErrors.test.tsx

limitations: App-level immediate history-selection and real Chromium regression are separate evidence coordinated by the parent.
